children.name: Protodrilus puniceus Sato-Okoshi, Okoshi & Fujiwara, 2015
children.description: Round prostomium with two terminal palps. No eyes. Thick bands of cilia around mouth, continuing ventrally along length of body. Slender filiform body, less than 5 mm long when preserved. Pygidium with two lateral lobes and a median cluster of cilia. Colour in ethanol white.
